license.notes: Original procedural construction. The recessed downlight grid in a fuel canopy's soffit: flush square pans with emissive lenses, laid out across the WHOLE deck by one prop rather than one prop per lamp, so a 24 x 10 m canopy costs two draw calls instead of two per unit. Dimensions are the canopy footprint, not one fixture. The lenses are emissive geometry only: max_lights_per_object is 8 on GL Compatibility and a literal fixture grid would put every light on the forecourt ground mesh, so the real illumination comes from a few wash anchors placed separately. Census 2026-09-26, Blender 5.1.1 (b70da489d7f4): min 6.0x4.0x0.15 224 tris, default 24.0x10.0x0.3 1176 tris, max 30.0x20.0x0.5 3024 tris, 0 coincident pairs at all three. The budget is set at the DEFAULT with headroom and is a regression detector, not a cap: this species' triangle count scales with the deck it covers, because the lamp count does. A max-size deck exceeds it and that is the species working.
